page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmr5s.24xlarge is a memory-optimized bare metal server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and features 96 dedicated physical cores and 96 vCPUs, utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, each vCPU maps directly to a physical core, eliminating hyperthreading overhead and providing dedicated compute resources.

The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, which translates to a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. No local storage is bundled with this server, meaning all storage requirements must be fulfilled through network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, and the configuration does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high memory-to-vCPU ratio position this instance as a premium, resource-dense option. It is designed for memory-intensive workloads requiring predictable, non-shared compute performance. Suitable workloads include large-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-heavy data processing pipelines.
